svg.title: Two reaction pathways fit sea-salt water uptake
svg.desc: SO₂ reaches sulfate through sulfuric-acid uptake or through oxidation of particle bisulfite. Against measured growth of 1.67 ± 0.02, the direct model gives 1.657 and the parallel model 1.654.
